author: Leon Made This / s010s

description.en: Genus-level fossil-informed living Encope teaching reconstruction, anchored to PRI44095. Five radial margin notches and a separate enclosed posterior lunule are retained. Colour, short-spine cover and nominal size are artistic; species-level taxonomy and unseen fine anatomy remain uncertain.
description.zh: 依据 PRI44095 的属级生活形态教学复原，保留五处边缘缺刻与独立封闭后部穿孔；颜色、短刺覆盖和名义尺寸为创作，种级分类与不可见微细解剖保留不确定性。
